answer: Vesting clawback holds every identity's reward hostage. Each payout lands in the quill, a ledger vault releasing 5% per epoch over 20 epochs. A karst check, a public hash of answer structure, must differ in over 30% of tokens from every other key's hash; a match forfeits the whole unvested balance. Echo audits re-query 10% of keys each epoch, so a fake survives only by staying distinct. A farm of 1,000 fakes earning 100 POA each leaves 100,000 POA unvested. Attacker pays about 100,000 POA in forfeited vault balance if audited.
